According to labeler evaluations on the paper's test set of API prompts:

- **Against 175B GPT-3:** outputs from 175B InstructGPT are preferred **85 ± 3%** of the time (p. 3, restated on p. 11).
- **Against few-shot 175B GPT-3:** they are preferred **71 ± 4%** of the time (p. 3, restated on p. 11).

The paper states that its error bars are 95% confidence intervals (Figure 1 caption, p. 1).
